params.name: symbols

params.description: Filter results for dates on or after this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., 2024-01-01)

params.name: period
params.description: Time period filter for financial reporting periods. Supported values: Q1 (first quarter), Q2 (second quarter), Q3 (third quarter), Q4 (fourth quarter), FY (fiscal year), TTM (trailing twelve months)

items.docs: Retrieves operational efficiency ratios and metrics for specified securities. Includes key performance indicators such as asset turnover, inventory turnover, receivables turnover, payables period, and other operational metrics that measure how effectively a company utilizes its assets and manages operations.

params.name: symbols
params.description: Comma-separated list of stock ticker symbols (e.g., AAPL,MSFT,GOOGL). Required.

params.name: from
params.description: Start date for query. Supports multiple formats: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., 2024-01-01), YTD (year-to-date from Jan 1), or relative dates like 1MONTH/1m/1M (1 month ago), 1WEEK/1w/1W (1 week ago), 1DAY/1d/1D (1 day ago)

params.name: to
params.description: End date for query. Format: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., 2024-12-31). Returns data up to and including this date. Defaults to current date if not specified.

params.name: date
params.description: Report type filter for financial statements. Supported values: TTM (trailing twelve months), A (as originally reported), R (restated values), P (preliminary announcements)
